finding.summary: The G-F1 built-image probe failed at 82d7a0f03: with the stale watcher assignment listed FIRST for the active side before the actor's command, the product accepted the Move (movement_declared seq 5 and movement_locked seq 6 are in the durable history) but withheld the declaration from the actor too, because MatchWireSealedChoices treats the first sideAssignments entry of a side as its only sealed owner. accepted() waits for the correlated declaration and timed out ("timeout waiting for reply to Move") in trusted-player-stale. accepted-Move, accepted-Attack and accepted-Physical passed in the same run.
finding.productDefect: Real product behaviour (co-op mission launch writes both players on one side; stale-owner-reachability.md section 2). It is fixed by the new unit MISSION-MATCH-1 after A2F (owner decisions 2026-10-26 item 1b). A2F changes no product file and does not depend on it.
